title: The Diamond Sutra
author: Unknown
description: A central Mahayana Buddhist scripture exploring wisdom beyond fixed concepts of self, possession and attainment. Through a dialogue between the Buddha and Subhuti, it challenges attachment to appearances and even to spiritual teachings themselves.
